EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tonight we're going to see a lovely
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Autumn Moon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It's a beautiful full
moon around harvest time.
I'm sure you can see it where you
live,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} too{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0003:001A:}}but I like the view from
here best.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Hoy vamos a ver una preciosísima
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Luna de Otoño{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Solo brilla así
durante el tiempo de la cosecha.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}De hecho, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}verás que la luna tendrá
un bello color trigo y todo.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Cette nuit, la lune va briller de mille
feux :{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} une {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}lune d'automne{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} comme on
n'en voit qu'une fois par an !
Tu n'en croiras pas tes yeux :{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} elle
scintille comme un joyau, une bague
d'ivoire flottant dans la nuit !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Stasera brillerà in cielo una favolosa
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}luna d'autunno{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Sarà rotonda
e luminosissimissima!
Proprio come un covone di grano
dopo la raccolta!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Heute Nacht werden wir einen
wunderbaren Vollmond zu sehen
bekommen.
Wir nennen ihn {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Autumn Moon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}},
und jeden Herbst, wenn er aufgeht,
feiern wir ein schönes Fest.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Tonight in {{TAG:0005:0005:}},{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} we'll be able
to see an amazing {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Autumn Moon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}The full moon shines so brightly at
this time of year.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} You don't want to
miss it!
Of course,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} you can see it in your
town too{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.but it'd be pretty cool
to say you saw it in both places!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}¡Que no se te olvide que esta noche
es la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Luna de Otoño{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}! {{TAG:0003:0025:}}Hay que salir
de casa y disfrutarla, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¿eh, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}bichín?
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La luna brilla como el oro en esta
época del año, {{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}¡no te la pierdas!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}C'est la pleine lune ce soir !{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} La {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}lune
d'automne {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}va resplendir comme une
bille argentée dans le ciel nocturne !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Stasera {{TAG:0005:0005:}} sarà rischiarata
da una stupenda {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}luna d'autunno{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Non devi assolutissimamente
perdertela! Sarà uno spettacolo
fantastique.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Es ist Herbst!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Und nicht nur das,
es ist beinahe Zeit für den goldenen
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Autumn Moon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Du solltest heute Abend unbedingt
etwas Zeit einplanen, um dir den
Vollmond anzuschauen.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0005:}}Bu gece {{TAG:0005:0005:}}'de,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} harika bir {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Sonbahar
Ayı{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} görebileceğiz.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}{{TAG:0000:0004:}}Yılın bu zamanında
dolunay gerçekten
çok parlak oluyor.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Kaçırmamalısın!
Elbette,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} kendi kasabanda da
görebilirsin{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.ama iki yerde de
gördüğünü söylemek hoş olurdu!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Tonight we'll get to see something
special.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} The {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Autumn Moon {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}is a full
moon right around harvest time.
I can't wait for it to light up the
night sky later!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Don't forget to look up tonight in
your town too!
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Esta noche seremos testigos de
la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Luna de Otoño{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}. Es una luna llena
que se ve en la época de la cosecha.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}¡Estoy deseando ver cómo
se ilumina el cielo esta noche!
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ce soir, un spectacle exceptionnel
nous attend :{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}lune d'automne{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} !{{TAG:0000:0004:}}C'est la pleine lune de la saison des
récoltes, elle brille comme une
pépite au cœur de la nuit !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Stasera il cielo sarà teatro
di un evento speciale e noi potremo
ammirare la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}luna d'autunno{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Non vedo l'ora che spunti e illumini
la notte! Sarà fantastique!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ich kann kaum erwarten, dass es
endlich dunkel wird.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Heute ist
Vollmond.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Aber nicht nur irgendeiner!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Es ist {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Autumn Moon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, und das
muss gebührend gefeiert werden.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Bu gece özel bir şey göreceğiz.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Sonbahar Ayı {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}hasat zamanı civarında
görülen bir dolunaydır.
Gece göğünü aydınlatmasını görmek için
sabırsızlanıyorum!{{TAG:0000:0004:}}{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Kendi kasabana
dönünce de bu gece
gökyüzüne bakmayı unutma!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Isn't the {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Autumn Moon {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}beautiful?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} It
shines so brightly at this time of
year.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Right around harvest time!
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}La luna d'autunno{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}} {{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}è belliiissima,
n'est-ce pas?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} La cornice ideale
per una bella cenetta!

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Isn't the moon beautiful tonight?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I
find myself stopping to stare up at
it.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} We call this an {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Autumn Moon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}!
I bet it looks pretty nice from your
town too,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Esta {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Luna de Otoño{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} transmite
una energía astral que es magnífica
para la regeneración de los chakras.
FR:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Tu as vu comme la lune est belle ce
soir ?{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}} C'est la {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}lune d'automne{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}, je
pourrais la contempler des heures !
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}La luna è un vero spettacolo oggi,
n'est-ce pas?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Non posso fare altro
che ammirarla.
Il suo colore dorato mi ricorda
le spighe di grano maturo.
Adoooro la nostra luna d'autunno!
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Der Vollmond fasziniert mich.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Ich bin wie hypnotisiert!{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ich kann
gar nicht weggucken, hihi.
Wenn der Mond im Herbst so
golden wird wie heute, nennen wir
das hier bei uns {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Autumn Moon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ay bu gece çok güzel değil mi?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}}
Kendimi durup durup ona bakarken
buluyorum.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Biz buna {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Sonbahar Ayı{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} diyoruz!
Eminim senin kasabandan da çok güzel
görünüyordur,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0005:0007:}}.

IT:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}La luna che risplende stasera
su {{TAG:0005:0005:}} è favolooosa.
Mi fa sentire diversa...
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Eh sì, la luna d'autunno fa venire
a tutti voglia di cambiare pelle
e di trasformarsi, n'est-ce pas?
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}{{TAG:0005:0005:}}'deki Ay bu gece gerçekten çok
güzel.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ama içimde tuhaf bir his
uyandırıyor{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}. Sanki{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.değişebilirmişim gibi.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Neyse.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Ben {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Sonbahar Ayı{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}'nı
olduğu gibi seyrederim:{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} hasat zamanı
civarında güzel bir dolunay.

EN:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}The full moon is gorgeous tonight,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
isn't it?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} I wish I had a camera that
could capture how it looks.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}But for now,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} I'll just gaze up at our
{{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Autumn Moon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} and think about the
fall harvest.
ES:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Qué luz tan bonita{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}.{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Cómo me
gustaría poder guardarla en
un botecito para verla siempre.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Pero como eso no se puede hacer,
{{TAG:0007:0000:0A000000}}prefiero concentrarme en gozar
de esta {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Luna de Otoño{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}.
IT:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Non ci sono parole per descrivere
la bellezza della luna d'autunno,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
n'est-ce pas?
Che beeello sarebbe poter catturare
un po' della sua luce e conservarla
in un barattolo di vetro...
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Ma forse è meglio così.
{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}La natura non deve essere
sottomessa alla nostra volontà.
DE:
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Wenn ich den {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Autumn Moon{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}} sehe,
werde ich jedes Jahr ein wenig
wehmütig.
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Ich wünsche mir dann immer, ich
könnte ein Glas Mondlicht abfüllen
und unter mein Bett stellen.
Dann würde es mir jede Nacht
leuchten, selbst wenn die Wolken
den Mond mal verdecken.
TRANSLATION:
{{TAG:0003:0001:}}Dolunay bu gece nefes kesici,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}}
değil mi?{{TAG:0007:0000:14000000}} Keşke görüntüsünü olduğu
gibi yakalayabilecek bir fotoğraf makinem olsaydı.
{{TAG:0003:0025:}}Şimdilik,{{TAG:0007:0000:08000000}} {{TAG:0000:0003:0200}}Sonbahar Ayı{{TAG:0000:0003:FFFF}}'na bakıp
sonbahar hasadını düşüneceğim.
